sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
Inosuke Nogami (野上伊之助) is a vassal of the Hirata family. He tried to protect the young lord Kuro, when bandits sieged the Estate, but was defeated by Lady Butterfly's illusions. He gives Wolf a Snap Seed, warning him of the danger he's about to face.
He is encountered in Ashina Outskirts, gravely wounded. His senile mother is in a nearby house awaiting his return with a bell in her hand. After Sekiro defeats Lady Butterfly, the Timid Maid will be found dead and Inosuke will too utter his last words before collapsing.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
- Outskirts Wall - Gate Path: next to the house with the Timid Maid inside, before the path guarded by a Cannoneer.
- Hirata Audience Chamber: by the Archer Bandit, just before Lady Butterfly.
First encounter | Inosuke: (Shallow breathing) Who is it? Is... somebody there?
"Say Nothing" | Wolf: .........
Inosuke: Sir? ...perhaps I'm imagining things...
"Answer" | Wolf: Yes.
Inosuke: ......That voice... No... Could it be? Sir? My name is Inosuke Nogami. A vassal of the Hirata family... or at least I was. I ask a favour... Might you look in on the old lady in that house? She's my mother, but... Her mind is failing... she cannot tell one from another.
Talking again | Inosuke: (Shallow breathing) Sir, is it you again? Please... Look after the old woman in that house. She doesn't know who anybody is anymore. She may have lost her mind, but she's still my mother...
Talking after receiving the Young Lord's Bell Charm | Inosuke: Sir? The man from before, right...? I wanted to thank you for humoring my mother... That bell's troubled her for a long, long time. She kept muttering incoherently... something about offering it to Buddha.
"Answer" if Wolf already has the Young Lord's Bell Charm | Wolf: Yes.
Inosuke: ......That voice... No... Could it be? Sir? My name is Inosuke Nogami. A vassal of the Hirata family... or at least I was. I ask a favour... Might you look in on the old lady in that house? She's my mother, but... Her mind is failing... she cannot tell one from another.
Wolf: ... I met your mother. She gave me a bell.
Inosuke: She did, did she...? You have my thanks. That bell's troubled her for a long, long time. She kept muttering incoherently... something about offering it to Buddha...
If the Timid Maid has the Dragonrot | Inosuke: Ahh... I can hear her wheezing. Mother... Mother... Augh! Why won't these legs of mine move?! (Holding back tears)
After the Timid Maid is cured of Dragonrot | Inosuke: Mother's wheezing... it stopped. (crying)... thank god...
First encounter when infected with Dragonrot | Inosuke: (Wheeze, wheeze, wheeze)
Wolf: Your breathing... Are you sick...?
Inosuke: (wheezing) Someone... any-... one...
Wolf: I'm here...
Inosuke: M-... My... mother... (coughs)
Wolf: Don't force it. You'll only make it worse...
Inosuke: Forget about... me... My mother... help my mother...
Inosuke: (Wheeze, wheeze, wheeze)
Wolf: You have the Dragonrot too...
Inosuke: (Hegh... hegh... hurh, ahhhh...) Someone... any-... one...
Wolf: I'm here...
Inosuke: M-... My... mother... (Hegh!) (Hegh, hegh, hegh!)
Wolf: Don't force it. You'll only make it worse...
Inosuke: Forget about... me... My mother... help my mother...
Leaving when infected with Dragonrot | Inosuke:
(Wheezing)
(wheezing and coughing up blood)
Greeting when infected with Dragonrot | Inosuke: (Wheezing with coughing)
"Take coughed up blood sample" | Wolf: I'm taking a blood sample.
Inosuke: (Wheeze... Wheeze... Cough, cough.)
Wolf: ... Now to bring this to Lady Emma.
After defeating Lady Butterfly | Inosuke: ...Ahh... Mother. Until the end... The young master... Heheheh...
First encounter | Inosuke: You... The young master's... I wouldn't go there if I were you. Dreadful illusion techniques... Without a Snap Seed, it cannot be overcome. Take this. (Gives Snap Seed [x1])
It's not much... but it's what I have.
Talking again | Inosuke: Listen... without a Snap Seed, you cannot overcome that illusion technique. I tried my best to be his guardian, but look at me now. The Hirata line is finished... I must save my mother at the very least...

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Neither him nor his mother are found anywhere in the alternate version of the Hirata Estate memory.
- Can't contact Dragonrot in Hirata Estate.
